title: footage_edit_plan
description: Advisory Gemini-derived edit grounding for a single raw talking-head take. Produced by FootageEditAnalyzer (tools/analysis/footage_edit_analyzer.py). NOT a canonical stage artifact — the edit-director agent still authors the canonical edit_decisions artifact, using this as grounding. Field mapping onto edit_decisions: beats[] -> cuts[] (one cut per beat, transition on cuts[].transition_in), beats[].b_roll -> overlays[] (when needed=true, windowed start/end_seconds), beats[].sound_effect -> audio.sfx[] (asset_id resolved from inventory_used.sound_effects by name), removal_spans[] -> dropped/trimmed from cuts[] by the edit-director. disfluency_spans[] is the raw, unfiltered Gemini output (for human QA); high-confidence entries are already merged into removal_spans[] with kind="disfluency" so the edit-director does not need to read disfluency_spans[] directly.

style_playbook.description: Path to the style playbook YAML used to parameterize this analysis.

start_seconds.description: start_time converted to seconds; maps to cuts[].in_seconds

end_seconds.description: end_time converted to seconds; maps to cuts[].out_seconds

type.description: Must be a member of inventory_used.transitions[]. Maps to cuts[].transition_in.
Must be a member of inventory_used.sound_effects[] or 'none'. Maps to audio.sfx[].

inventory_used.description: Provenance of the constrained menu injected into the prompt (from Phase 01b resource_inventory.json).

disfluency_spans.description: Raw speech-disfluency detections from this Gemini call (word/phrase repetition, false start, self-correction) — semantic judgment that dead-air/lexicon-based detection (speech_gap_detector.py) cannot catch. Kept unfiltered here for human QA; high-confidence entries (>= min_disfluency_confidence) are additionally merged into removal_spans[] with kind="disfluency".

stumbled_fragment.description: Verbatim quote of the stumbled/repeated/abandoned words.

clean_continuation.description: Verbatim quote of the corrected/continued words spoken right after.

removal_spans.description: Filler-word/dead-air spans merged in from Phase 03 (speech_gap_detector), plus high-confidence disfluency_spans[] detected by this tool's own Gemini call.

broll_candidates.description: Real b-roll clips this project declared (input.broll_sources), each with a Gemini-produced one-sentence content description. Empty when the project has no real b-roll footage -- b_roll.needed beats then have nothing to match and must fall back to no-insert rather than a fabricated visual. See footage_edit_broll_matcher.match_broll_to_beats for how these get matched to beats.

_analysis_meta.description: Reproducibility + QA metadata. Not part of the creative artifact.

inventory_violations.description: Beats where Gemini named a transition/sfx outside the injected inventory. Clamped to a safe value ('none') in the returned beats[]; recorded here for QA visibility rather than silently discarded.
